text:
**Short answer: about 200-300 W of solar for a one-day recharge, and 400 W if you only get ~3 sun hours.**

**The formula:** Panel watts ≈ 1,000 Wh ÷ (peak sun hours × ~0.7-0.8 efficiency)

The sources use slightly different loss factors (0.68 to 0.8), so the numbers vary a bit:

| Peak sun hours | Panel watts for a one-day full recharge |
|---|---|
| 3 (winter/cloudy) | ~400-450 W |
| 4 | ~300-340 W |
| 5 (good summer) | ~240-300 W |
| 6 (desert Southwest) | ~200-230 W |

Sources: [Power Runtime](https://power-runtime.pages.dev/guides/solar-charging/), [Held in Reserve](https://www.heldinreserve.com/power/solar-panels-recharge-power-station/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/how-many-watts-solar-panel-to-recharge-1000wh-portable-power-station-solar-charg).

**If you don't need a one-day recharge:** A 200 W panel is a common pairing. At 4.5 peak sun hours it puts roughly 630 Wh per day into the battery, so about a day and a half to fill from empty ([Watt48](https://www.watt48.com/guides/solar-panel-charging-power-station), [Power Preflight](https://powerpreflight.com/guides/solar-panel-sizing-portable-power-stations/)).

**Check before you buy:**
- **Solar input limit:** Your station caps how many watts it accepts. Mid-range 1,000-1,500 Wh units often allow 400-800 W, but some cap at 200 W. Panels above the cap add nothing.
- **Voltage range:** Panel voltage must fall within the station's input window (often 12-60 V).
- **Season:** Winter at northern latitudes can need 700 W or more for a one-day refill, and heavy overcast makes it impractical.

**A panel that fits the 400 W case:** The [ALLPOWERS SP037 400 W foldable panel](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel) is listed at $299, or $269.10 with code ALLPOWERS26 (10% off, per Dealectric's test, expires 2026-12-30). Caveats:
- It has 37.4 V working / 45.3 V open-circuit voltage, so it suits stations with 12-60 V inputs (e.g., certain ALLPOWERS and BLUETTI models) but not low-voltage ones like the Tenergy T320 or BLUETTI Elite 30 V2.
- It weighs 18.5 kg, which is heavy for a folding panel.
- That link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy.
